items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: Well, Clarence had to do good for everybody that was from Chicago, because that was kind of a syndicate.

ctx.x: In late years, that last couple of years of Jelly's life when he was writing music, Clarence Williams was trying to sell the music there, and it was the agent.
Well, Clarence had to do good for everybody that was from Chicago, because that was kind of a syndicate.
